page: Amazon Web Services c6id.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on the AWS Nitro System and powered by 3rd Generation Intel Xeon Scalable 8375C processors. The instance provides 64 vCPUs across 32 physical cores with multithreading enabled at a clock speed of 3.5 GHz. It includes 128.0 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, establishing a 1:2 core-to-memory ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware features include 54 MB of L3 cache alongside instruction support for AVX-512 with VNNI, AES-NI, and SHA-NI cryptographic extensions.

Local instance storage is integrated directly with 3,800 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, providing low-latency ephemeral disk access without reliance on network-attached volumes. Networking throughput delivers a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. While the system does not include dedicated graphics processing units, its dedicated x86_64 CPU resources provide deterministic execution across compute-heavy operations.

Benchmark results highlight strong multi-threaded compute, scoring in the top quartile for stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and PassMark database operations. Extended instruction benchmarks and hardware encryption leverage the integrated AVX-512 and crypto instructions effectively. Single-threaded metrics, including single-core stress-ng and Geekbench runs, register within the middle 50 percent category, reflecting standard per-core IPC rather than specialized high-frequency burst behavior.

The hardware configuration offers favorable resource density for multi-threaded workloads needing high scratch disk throughput. The bundled NVMe storage removes external EBS IOPS bottlenecks, making the instance technically suited for large software compilation pipelines, distributed database nodes, real-time media transcoding, static web serving clusters, and batch data processing.
description: Amazon Web Services c6id.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance running on the AWS Nitro hypervisor with 64 vCPUs across 32 physical Intel Xeon 8375C cores at 3.5 GHz. Configured with a 1:2 compute-to-memory ratio, it supplies 128.0 GB of DDR4 RAM and 3,800 GB of local NVMe SSD instance storage, supplemented by a 25 Gbps baseline network link. The processor supports AVX-512 and hardware cryptographic instructions. Benchmark results demonstrate top-quartile performance in multi-core compute, clang software compilation, PassMark database operations, and multi-threaded data decompression, contrasted with average single-thread metrics. The large bundled NVMe storage volume paired with dense compute cores makes the c6id.16xlarge well suited for continuous integration build runners, relational database nodes, batch processing pipelines, and high-throughput static web serving.
